headline: Pain relief, better sleep and less drinking: this week's research
dek: Three studies that land on the medical and public-health side of the debate.
body: A review of 13 randomized clinical trials found inhaled cannabis made meaningful pain relief more likely. A separate study tied medical cannabis to sleep improvements that held for two years.
From Germany, new data shows alcohol use and alcohol-related hospital stays kept falling after legalization, while cannabis offenses dropped 53%.
On the other side, medical professionals report gaps in their cannabis training that leave them unsure how to advise athletes using it for pain, sleep and recovery.
